Lena (People Ops): Quick announcement: we've updated the Performance Review & Calibration section in the handbook and are rolling out a mandatory Unconscious Bias micro-training for all people managers. Please skim the change and complete the 20-min training by Mon 2 weeks from today. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/performance#calibration :spiral_calendar:
Chris (HRBP): Summary for managers: 1) New calibration panel members listed in the appendix; 2) Managers must submit a 3-sentence calibration rationale for any rating change >1 bucket; 3) Managers must complete the bias micro-training before submitting final ratings.
Alicia (Eng Manager): Are ICs required to take the micro-training too, or only managers?
Lena (People Ops): Only managers this cycle — the training focuses on calibration decisions and pattern recognition. We'll revisit for ICs next quarter.
Mateo (SWE): If a manager doesn't complete training by the deadline, what happens to their reviews?
Priya (Legal): Escalation flow: missing training blocks the manager from finalizing ratings in PerformanceHub. HRBP will follow up and place a hold until completed. If there is a documented hardship, route to HRBP for exception.
Chris (HRBP): Tracking note: we're using LearningCenter to enroll people automatically. Managers will get an email with e-sign and the training link. We'll publish a manager roster (view-only) and update status nightly. Roster: https://sheets.redwood.com/ops/perf-calib-185261.
Alicia (Eng Manager): Can I see my team's completion status without the sheet? Any API?
Chris (HRBP): We can add a manager dashboard view in PerformanceHub next week. For now, sheet + nightly digest is the source of truth.
Lena (People Ops): Calendar blockers: calendar invites for calibration panels sent; please block the 2-hour slot even if you think you won't need full time.
ComplianceBot: automated reminder: 18 managers pending training completion — next reminder in 48h. :bell:
Mateo (SWE): Noted. Also adding a quick note: would be helpful to include examples of acceptable calibration rationale in the appendix.
Lena (People Ops): Good idea — adding 3 anonymized examples now. If you have ones to share, DM me.
Chris (HRBP): Action items recap: 1) Managers complete micro-training by deadline; 2) Submit calibration rationale for >1-bucket changes; 3) HRBP will monitor sheet and escalate holds to People Ops/Legal if needed.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks team. We'll post a short rollout FAQ after the first weekly calibration. If anything breaks, ping #people-ops-inline or DM me. :handshake:
